sentences.en: Algeria's subsoil is overflowing with riches.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的地底下蕴藏着丰富的资源。

sentences.en: The roots of the tree grow in the subsoil, absorbing nutrients.
sentences.zh: 树根生长在下层土中，吸收养分。

sentences.en: Testing the subsoil is crucial before building on this site.
sentences.zh: 在该地建房之前测试下层土至关重要。
